我们试图将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而这一行动酿成了一场血战，甚至在我们登船之后惨烈的战斗仍未停息。冲突十分激烈，没有船员幸存——似乎所有受伤的战斗人员都宁愿自杀，也不允许自己被俘。

尽管它们在最后的时间里急匆匆地抹除了电脑系统，并试图让舰船自爆，它们的舰船还是完好无损地落入了我们的手中。我方的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正开始工作，试图从中发掘出有用的信息。
texts.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. So ferocious was the struggle that no living survivors remained - it seems that wounded combatants committed suicide rather than permit themselves to be captured.

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.

texts.zh:
我们本想将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而甚至在我们登船之后还爆发了惨烈的火拼之后才达成。看上去我们的对手是受某个失控人工智能管制的机械体无人机，一旦信号丢失就会启动自毁命令。

尽管它们在最后的时间里急匆匆地抹除了电脑系统，并试图让舰船自爆，它们的舰船还是完好无损地落入了我们的手中。我方的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正开始工作，试图从中发掘出有用的信息。
texts.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a savage firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. It appears that our opponents were mechanical drones piloted by a rogue AI, which evidently gave the order to self-destruct as soon as their cause seemed lost.

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.

texts.zh:
我们试图将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而这一行动酿成了一场血战，甚至在我们登船之后惨烈的战斗仍未停息。舰船的船员表现出了极高的协调性——就好像受单一的思维控制一样——并十分凶猛地与我方人员交战，绝不后退一步。最终它们宁愿击杀自己也不允许被敌人俘虏。

尽管它们在最后的时间里急匆匆地抹除了电脑系统，并试图让舰船自爆，它们的舰船还是完好无损地落入了我们的手中。我方的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正开始工作，试图从中发掘出有用的信息。
texts.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. The crew of the ship moved with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - and gave a fierce struggle, refusing to back down and eventually killing themselves rather than permit themselves to be captured.

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.

texts.zh:
我们成功瘫痪了来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索舰，但登舰过程中爆发的冲突意外升级为致命交火。起初这群[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星生物展现出超乎预期的协同作战能力，宛如共享同一意识。然而当我方取得军事优势后，这些生物突然陷入全面混乱。其行为模式迅速退化为原始而野蛮的状态，完全丧失组织性，最终被迅速歼灭。

现有证据表明，这些低等智慧生物曾隶属于某个格式塔意识。那个操纵它们的未知存在显然宁可选择自我毁灭也不愿被俘获——最终留给我们的只有可回收的舰体残骸，其中充斥着嗜血野兽与蠕动的异星植被。
texts.en:
We managed to disable the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a skirmish that became decidedly more deadly as we boarded their ship. At first the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated, as though acting with one mind. However once we pressed our military advantage, the creatures suddenly lost all cohesion. From that point their behavior reverted to something primal, bestial, and entirely uncoordinated. Their end came swiftly.

We can only posit that these barely-sapient creatures were once operating as part of a gestalt. Whichever entity was guiding them seems to have favored self-destruction over capture; it left us with nought but a salvageable hull filled with ravening beasts and twitching vegetation.

label.zh: 这艘船会把它们的秘密都显露出来。
label.en: The ship will surely yield their secrets.

texts.zh:
我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

或许值得庆幸的是，无论是为了他们自己的尊严还是保护我们的情报不落入敌手，我们的船员在被俘虏之前英勇就义了。然而，我们必须假定攻击者很快就会通过研究我们的船只获取我们的情报——面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。
texts.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

Perhaps fortunately - both for them and the sake of keeping information from enemy hands - our crew took their own lives rather than permit themselves to be captured. However, we must assume that our assailants will soon find out much about us by studying our vessel - and that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

texts.zh:
风险决策部分从一开始就知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。[From.Owner.GetName]的行动证明了他们是对的。我们的舰船被扣押了，还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，过载了我们的防御，为了保护我们的信息，我们发布了让我们的无人自毁的指令。然而，我们必须假定攻击者很快就会通过研究我们的船只获取我们的情报——面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。
texts.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, were able to overwhelm our defenses, so we gave the order for our drones to decommission themselves so as to protect the security of our information. However, we must assume that our assailants will soon find out much about us by studying our vessel. As a result, we have significantly increased our evaluation of the danger posed by them.

Our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens that moved with such coordination as to suggest a unified intelligence much like our own - were able to overwhelm our defenses, so we gave the order for our drones to decommission themselves so as to protect the security of our information. texts.zh:
我们长久以来一直怀疑，如果星系其他地方存在生命，它们可能会对我们构成威胁，其危险程度不亚于游荡的奇点或恒星辐射。如今，这一怀疑已被证实。我们的一艘探索舰遭到[from.owner.GetName]的袭击并登舰——对方在飞船上的共生体尚未撤离时就发动了进攻。

我们的袭击者——一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人——很快击溃了我们的防御，他们优先攻击了那些被其识别为生命体的部分。出于自保，我们被迫抛弃了舰上所有成员，将其隔绝于我们的意识共鸣之外。尽管来犯者如此猖獗，他们终将一无所获。

这是一次赤裸裸的侵略行径，但至少我们现在更清楚地认识到，在这片星海中还将面临何种威胁。
texts.en:
We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, soon overwhelmed our defenses, having prioritized those parts of us they actually recognized as lifeforms. As an act of self-preservation we were forced to abandon all those aboard, isolating them from our chorus. For all their aggression, our attackers shall learn little from us.

An act of naked transgression has been directed toward us, but now at least we do know more about the kinds of threats we face elsewhere in this galaxy.
